overview.title: Results
overview.description: Items returned by the SocialCrawl API call. Credit and request metadata are attached on each row under `_sc_`-prefixed fields (`_sc_credits_used`, `_sc_credits_remaining`, `_sc_request_id`, `_sc_cached`, and `_sc_page` when auto-paginating). The complete, untouched API envelope is also saved to the run's key-value store as OUTPUT.
